meta.important: POI guarantees and unique story item sources are inherited and never randomized

globalPolicies.bonusRollsTiming: Generate at first eligible interaction; persist immutable item list in save before reward claim
globalPolicies.storageFull: Items remain in POI container/ground safe pickup state until collected; blueprints are learned in journal immediately
globalPolicies.lootAtomicity: Write encounterOutcome and grant status in one save transaction; idempotent eventId POI_ID:REWARD_V1
globalPolicies.sourceIsolation: POI special items/blueprints never appear in random pools, storm loot, animals or regenerated resource nodes
globalPolicies.worldSeedDeterminism: same seed + same POI id + same version => same optional bonus picks
globalPolicies.lootRollStyle: One guaranteed utility roll + extra rare roll when configured; rolled duplicates per POI are merged
globalPolicies.noSoftlocks: Story specials non-droppable, world guarantees remain even when inventory is full; special progression not reliant on random rolls
globalPolicies.weightInterpretation: Weights are relative within one pool, not global drop probabilities

poiLoot.uniqueRewardPolicy: Unique plan and story special are never random, never lost, never rolled again; if already learned, no repeat grant
